even_odd: uniform on the six ring nodes of the matching parity
target_for_candidate_scoring: full endpoint TV at every integer n; ordinary least squares on log(y-P), raw absolute RMSE on each window, include every y>=1e-8; skip invalid or unidentified parameters; signed first-axis contrast scored separately
fixed_plateau: period12 fitted by residue class arithmetic means; pure exponential and power fit with P=0, plateau+exp with P=0.5 fixed; exact analytic plateau from each case is a separate diagnostic
scalar: first raw coordinate (Bernoulli), for each probability law separately
spectrum_reference: 13x13 eigenvalues and exact short independent word/origin branching through n=24
direct: binary64 full mu,nu and separately propagated signed delta through all 65537 times
low_frequency_comparison: training and untouched holdout; parity sign, Fourier envelope and slow reset time scales fixed before run
